newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan hospital says five Israelis dead on arrival.
newsitem.headline: Jordan hospital says five Israelis dead on arrival.

text.p: Five Israelis hit in a shooting on the Jordanian border on Thursday were dead on arrival in hospital in northern Jordan, a hospital official told Reuters by telephone.
"It looks like they were all schoolgirls who were on a tourist bus," the official said. "Five of them were dead on arrival at the hospital."
They said another two wounded Israelis were being operated on at the hospital in Shuna.
Health Minister Aref Batayneh said the two wounded Israelis would be taken to a hospital later on the outskirts of Amman.
Officials said Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti would fly by helicopter to the scene.
